why: Two measured collisions in the shared TEMP root: on 2026-10-12 one worker read another session's edit6.mjs and another committed with an m1.txt message file a different session had overwritten; on 2026-10-18 a worker's mutant-campaign output written to /tmp was overwritten by a peer's reaper campaign. A delegated agent's write there is refused; its worktree and its <tmp>/claude/ scratchpad are the places that belong to it.
